systems.name: 4.1 Sprite Standards Compliance
systems.notes: Create sprite QA pipeline: 1:1 scale, cyan transparency key, Doom PLAYPAL palette, 8-frame cycles, 128×128 canvas, full cyan border. All sprites must pass automated checks.
tasks: Build a sprite validator tool (border, palette, transparency)
Define sprite sheet template (2×4 grid, 8px padding)
Create automation to check all sprites against standards
Document sprite naming conventions and rotation groups

systems.name: 4.2 Character & Enemy Art
systems.notes: Produce all character sprites: SHI/VA (player, multiple states), Backspace (NPC), Enforcers, broadcast dead variants, bosses, and drones.
tasks: SHI/VA: idle, walk, attack, hurt, death, special frames
Backspace: idle, talk, hand-over-item frames
Enforcer: patrol, shoot, melee, death, alert frames
Broadcast dead: shamble, attack, death, glitched variant
Bosses: unique multi-frame animations

systems.name: 4.3 Environmental Textures
systems.notes: Create texture sets for each chapter: gutter neon, corporate archive, sterile corpo, cathedral, blackout, and dead-signal zones. Follow Doom palette and tile size constraints.
tasks: Static City: rain-slicked bricks, neon signs, trash
Archives: data towers, flickering screens, cold metal
Corpo districts: white panels, blue light strips, glass
Cathedral: reactor core, stained-light windows, cables
Blackout: dark emergency lights, debris, ash

systems.name: 4.4 Weapon & Item Graphics
systems.notes: Design ChemScrubber, Firewall module, data shards, Karma Coins, and any other pickups. Must fit the 320×200 weapon logic.
tasks: ChemScrubber pickup and HUD icon
Firewall module pickup and active indicator
Data shard collectible sprites
Karma Coin and health/armor items

systems.name: 4.5 Sound Design & Voice
systems.notes: Create all sound effects: weapons, enemy sounds, ambient loops, UI beeps, and voice lines for Backspace, Moon, PA system, and Pirate broadcast.
tasks: Weapon sounds (gunfire, ChemScrubber hiss)
Enemy sounds (Enforcer commands, dead groans)
Ambient loops per chapter (rain, hum, static)
Voice recording and processing for key characters
Mix and master all audio to consistent levels
